description: This source file defines the 'Zoneinfo' struct and functions to parse and extract memory zone information from '/proc/zoneinfo' in Linux systems, part of the 'procfs' package.

classes.name: Zoneinfo
classes.description: Struct holding parsed information from /proc/zoneinfo, including various memory zone metrics and NUMA statistics.

methods.name: FS.Zoneinfo
methods.description: Reads and parses the /proc/zoneinfo file, returning a slice of Zoneinfo structs.

methods.name: parseZoneinfo
methods.description: Parses the byte data from /proc/zoneinfo into a slice of Zoneinfo structs.
